summary: Iteration 3: Verified the stuck-loading bug fix (3 scenarios) plus regression on navigation, data rendering, add-batch+undo, and Mark Paid flow, and backend core API regression. All primary bug-fix scenarios PASS. No page errors in normal or API-blocked mode. Backend endpoints return 200 with seeded data (6 batches, 12 students, 44 payments). Data restored to clean seeded state via /api/reset + /api/seed.

minor.issue: Unknown id returns 200 {"ok":true} instead of 404 (silent no-op); same pattern likely for batches/payments/events deletes

Pre-existing test isolation flakiness: /app/backend/tests/test_import_export.py mutates global DB (reset/import) and runs in parallel via xdist, causing cross-test failures when the whole suite runs together (test_list_batches, test_seed_idempotent, test_export_shape failed in full-suite run; all pass when run per-file). Test-infra only, not an app defect.

issues: Payment Date uses the browser-native <input type=date> picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component (inconsistent with app design system)

action_items: Optional: return 404 for delete of non-existent resources
Optional: replace native date input in PaymentModal with shadcn Calendar
Optional: make import/export tests isolation-safe (they wipe the shared DB) or mark them serial
critical_code_review_comments: store.js retryLoad correctly uses try/catch/finally so setLoading(false) always runs — root cause of the stuck loader is fixed; axios timeout 20000ms bounds hangs.

doUndo/doRedo perform async side effects inside setState updaters (entry.undo().then(refresh) inside setUndoStack) — works but is not React-18 strict-mode safe (updaters must be pure and can be invoked twice). Recommend moving the async call outside the updater.
Load failure only logs to console; no toast/telemetry — acceptable since ErrorScreen exposes recovery.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 core tests when run isolated; 10/10 import-export isolated)

seed_data_creation: Created and then undone: TEST_Batch_QA batch; recorded then undid one payment for student Sejati. Final state restored with POST /api/reset + POST /api/seed (6 batches, 12 students, 44 payments, 0 events).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug-fix verification details: normal load reaches dashboard-page with stats (12 students, 6 batches, pending Rs10,400 for Sep 2026); blocking route '**/api/**' with abort -> ErrorScreen appears within ~2s (abort fails fast, no need to wait for the 20s axios timeout), 'Could not load data' + retry-load-btn visible, loading screen gone; unroute + click retry-load-btn recovers to dashboard. Navigation to all 5 pages OK, 12 student cards, 6 batch cards, 35 calendar day cells, overview 12 overdue rows / Rs15,250. Mark Paid opens the Record Payment modal (pay-full then payment-save) — clicking mark-paid alone does not record a payment. Note undo-btn is disabled after a page reload (stacks are in-memory).
rca_of_the_issue: Original stuck loader: seed()/refresh() rejections left loading=true forever. Fix (try/catch/finally + loadError + retryLoad + axios timeout) verified end-to-end.
